description: Run a retirement Monte Carlo simulation in today's dollars: probability that savings last through the planning age, the range of portfolio values at retirement and at the end, median depletion age when paths fail, the initial withdrawal rate, the effect of three levers (save more, retire two years later, spend 10% less) and the highest spending that keeps the target success rate. Required: currentAge, retirementAge, planToAge, savings and spending. Return and volatility default to afa's capital market assumptions for the chosen model (a step more conservative in retirement); other optional inputs default to 0, and inflation to 2.5%. Results are hypothetical.

distribution.description: normal (default) or fat-tailed returns (Student-t), which make severe years more frequent.

model.description: Model portfolio used for omitted return and volatility inputs: conservative (20% stocks), moderately_conservative (40% stocks), moderate (60% stocks), growth (75% stocks), aggressive (90% stocks). Default moderate.

otherIncome.description: Social Security, pensions and other income per year, in today’s dollars.

seed.description: Random seed; the same inputs and seed give the same result (default 1).

spending.description: Annual retirement spending from the portfolio and other income, in today’s dollars.

targetSuccess.description: Success rate in percent used for sustainable spending (default 85).

withdrawalTaxRate.description: Average tax rate on withdrawals in percent; withdrawals are grossed up for it (default 0).

name: retirement_plan
title: Retirement plan (Monte Carlo)
